theme: Live/Context Index — Layer 1: a deterministic, offline, native-Postgres-FTS view of the operator's project context (docs/runbooks/repo/tickets) feeding the composer's plan-time context. The reserved agent-workspace edge is enforced on exactly one read-only path (context.search), same-grant-scoped by construction, confined to a registered source root, per-read chained fail-loud. The read plane completes: remember (L2, v0.8/v0.9) + know the current context (L1, v0.10) -> compose -> govern -> act -> accrue. Zero embeddings, zero model dependency, zero egress, zero new third-party dependency.
status: release-candidate — the CEO §human WD-10 walkthrough (T-104) is the remaining gate; only sign-off flips these artifacts to released and lands the local annotated tag v0.10.0 (no remote, per repo doctrine)

The ADR ladder is CANONICAL_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md (through ADR-0066). AS-BUILT NOTE: ADR-0066 and the release criteria both name the seam internal/context in prose; T-097 renamed it to internal/ctxindex (package context collided with the Go stdlib context package) — a naming fix, zero behavioral difference, reconciled in release_notes_v0_10_0.md and used correctly in all living docs (module-map.md, agent-permission-model.md). WD-10 (the loop: register a charter-bound context source -> the in-process indexer sweeps deterministically -> the composer's chained memory.read AND context.search reads -> the composed plan parks as a proposed Run -> informed approve -> the unchanged engine executes and accrues -> a live source edit is reflected on the NEXT context.search without a full rebuild; plus the live negatives N1 cross-grant/foreign-source no-oracle / N2 confined-root guard / N3 staleness honesty / N4 per-read chained fail-loud incl. zero-result calls / N5 zero-new-dependency / N6 always-park under an injection-flavored fixture) is green on compose (task e2e, PASS 366.8s, chain intact 616 events) and installed (task wd1, PASS 651.6s against the 1500s ceiling / 43%, chain intact 222 events, at the TRUE production posture: the 60s context-indexer sweep floor AND the 60s adaptive-schedule floor, neither overridden). WD-5/6/7/8/9 all stay green as the elevated regression guard. Chain counts are observed values (timing-dependent legs), not invariant assertions — integrity + per-leg exact counts are the assertions, per the v0.9 precedent.
